pairing: Same source, five construction cases, eight permitted paths, budget eight and four runtime root inputs with eight output expectations. Only construction order differs in the first pair.
model_observation: The first predicted mask 7 matched 13/15 construction fields and 3/5 complete cases. Finite continuation selected mask 3, which matched 15/15 fields and 5/5 cases. Ranking used two attempts versus four with deterministic ordering. The initial model prediction was incomplete despite its high reported probability.
replay_observation: Same generated native projection in all four observations. Replay retains previous generation/model evidence and makes zero current model calls. Input-only replay uses three new rows without expected values and reports OBSERVED, not accuracy. No model path or provider setting is supplied to replay.
measurement_scope: One sequential pair on a shared host, cache not reset, no repeated timing comparison. Whole command and child runtime metrics have separate scope; historical prediction timing in saved receipts is not a new replay prediction. macOS time -lp output is rounded and its maximum RSS is a process high-water observation, not total concurrent process memory.
reproduction: Build cmd/gooo from compiler_revision with Go 1.27.1.
Run package execute --json --cases CASES WORKSPACE with an explicit --go GO1_27_1; redirect output to execution.json.
For the model route add --assembly-model MODEL_JSON using the pinned shared QAT model; compare source digests and candidate budgets.
Run package replay --json --receipt execution.json --cases CASES WORKSPACE; omit all model options.
Run package replay --json --receipt execution.json --inputs FRESH_INPUTS WORKSPACE for actual values without an oracle.
